Summary:
Alice Helbenat, a shy girl who loves reading.
However, her pedigree is top class even within this academy.
She carries the blood of royalty from a small European nation, and she’s a devout believer.
On top of that, she’s the younger sister of the chairman.

Like the other students, she harbors hidden desires she can't speak of.
The only difference being that she openly asked the chairman to fulfill those desires herself.
A girl who manages to leave not only the protagonist, but even the chairman at a loss.

And so, for her sake, the protagonist plays his role as the "priest" who will offer her guidance.
